capabilities.summary: Text cards are rich blocks (blockType text, CARD_STYLE); a VisualPlan text node renders as one.
Headings are frameless text rich blocks, not a kind of their own.
Native shapes plus composite ones (cylinder, hexagon, document, …) with a bound label.
Arrows bound at both ends carry a label, a typed relation and edge semantics (explanation, confidence).
19 relation types incl. calls/reads/writes/publishes/subscribes/contains. No contrasts_with, refines, part_of, evidenced_by, causes (caused_by exists, reversed direction) or uses.
A VisualPlan group renders as an Excalidraw frame with a title and optional takeaway; members point to it with parent. Frames are not domain objects.
Frames cannot nest; nested groups are expressed as linked frames (Lens expandsTo / explained_by) or as sub-topic backdrops inside a frame.
evidence: .ai/docs/acute-lens-plan.md §3.1 'Why a link and not nested frames'

capabilities.summary: Rules for splitting an oversized frame by meaning are not implemented; frames grow to fit, and overflow folds into 'More from this section' pages.
Table rich blocks; tables can also be placed by reference to the source ({type:'source',ref:'T1'}).
Code rich blocks with a language; mermaid and acute-chart code blocks preview.
Todo rich blocks (items with checked state). No owner or due-date fields: owners and dates live in the item text.
A plan page node becomes a BlockNote page shown on the canvas as a page preview (compact card or content preview).
Images exist on the canvas and in pages, but a VisualPlan image node is typed and never renderable: no template allows it and mapNode throws.
Architecture node kinds (frontend … store) and project kinds (decision, constraint, open_question, risk, …) colour shapes and drive Lens.
Distinct card styles for main idea / example / evidence (master plan Wave 1b item 3). Today only importance and origin:'analysis' exist on plan nodes.
The pipeline's output contract: VisualPlan v1 with typed nodes, groups and relationships, validated leniently.
The 'sectioned' template allows every renderable node type and every relation type; it is the only template that has frames together with calls/reads/writes.
The 'architecture' template drops calls/reads/writes/publishes/subscribes/contains relationships and group nodes; labelled code-level edges need the sectioned template.
An outline step picks sections and classifies them (comparison, flow, decision, …); one plan call per section, in parallel. Extraction and grouping happen in that same call.
Layout is deterministic code, not the model.
A section's one-line takeaway shown under its frame title.
Today's only quality measure: a unit counts as covered at >= 70% of its significant words; uncovered units are re-attached verbatim.
Opaque, version-matched source unit ids (u17) with hash, topic and neighbours. Today blocks are numbered per run only (T1, P1).
cites: string[] on VisualNode and AIMetadata.sourceUnits; not in src.

A reply carrying an ideas list (type, citations, conditions) before the nodes that refer to it, so knowledge (gate 1) is checked before organisation (gate 2). Proposed 2026-10-19; not in the plan's reply shape yet.
FIDELITY_CONFIG.noteModel ('preserve' | 'distil') and DISTIL_RULE; FIDELITY_CONFIG has neither today.
Represented / Intentionally omitted / Needs review per unit, critical units, omission reasons.
Deterministic fidelity rules (dropped qualifier, changed condition, cause flip, added absolute, negation flip, unsupported number).
Source tab with two-way highlighting and the card's own source version.
Needs review queue and amber flags for uncertain cards.
Per-object provenance (createdBy, task, model, operationId, sourceRefs) and the content source/version a card came from.
Append-only, device-local source versions with pathIds (renamed headings) and revisions.
VisualNode.sourceSpan exists; spans are reliable only from the local tier.
Update from new content diffs sections (topic units), keeps unchanged ones without a model call, and classifies objects as add / remove / update_clean / update_conflict / unchanged.
A user-edited object is detected by fingerprint and becomes a conflict ('Keep mine'), never silently overwritten.
stableNodeKey = '<unit> § <node key>', and topic ids survive heading renames.
Citation-driven, per-card updates with unit lineage and ambiguous matches routed to review (R2).
A group with diagram:'architecture' (or kinded member shapes) becomes an interactive frame with kinds, details, info cards and a legend.
Archify JSON and Mermaid (incl. architecture-beta) convert deterministically to plans.
Architecture profile L0 System … L5 Source; group content.level carries a section's level.
Lens derives its graph from canvas frames (no second copy): lensView / lensTree over a SceneSource.
Lens key from acuteNode.key, then the reconciliation key, then the element id; copies drop keys, moves keep them.
Drill-down via acuteNode.expandsTo or an explained_by arrow to a frame; crumbs roll back up.

A VisualPlan can't set expandsTo (only the set_lens change kind, MCP link_lens_detail or the UI can); a plan expresses drill-down only as an explained_by link to a node in the child frame or via Repo Map section.parent.
Code evidence from acuteNode.sources (user) and sourceRefs 'path#La-b@commit' (MCP); L5 shows a source card. Acute never reads the files.
Path tracing across levels and edges (BFS).
Canvas evidence carries {canvasId, elementId}; selecting it reveals the canonical element.
Staged change sets are shown as proposed ghosts, never merged before Accept.
Edges carry confidence and explanation; there is no 'unknown / unavailable detail' marker on nodes or levels.
An adapter from lensTree output to the dataset's normalised LensProjection, so a real canvas can be scored. Not built in this task.
lens_review / lens_assess with a 14 HLD / 11 LLD question bank; verified only with the mock provider, never a real model.
The IDE agent sends map sections (levels, nodes keyed mod:/file:/sym:, source path#lines); Acute extracts nothing itself.
Unit suite runs src/**/*.test.ts only; contract tests (live) are separate.
Layout checks for overlaps, crossings and links through cards exist for the renderer, run on generated change sets.
Replays of recorded AI replies exist for Visualize e2e (ACUTE_REPLAY_DIR) and chat updates; the golden dataset adds recordings/ for quality replay.
